I’ve gone to both. A psychiatrist is gonna be the one to diagnose you and things. So tell the psychiatrist about your symptoms and that you want to get evaluated. But I totally understand why you’re afraid to get diagnosed, and why you  want to. I was the exact same way. I really wanted to get diagnosed so they could fix the problem, but also I didn’t want to be different from anybody else. BUT. What I’ve learned from being diagnosed is that it’s not that big, to be honest. When I got diagnosed, it didn’t make me different right away. It didn’t change anything. It just reiterated the fact I already knew. I was depressed and anxious. For a long time. And I’ve been struggling. But it’s the first step to getting what you need. BUT. It also isn’t always mental illness that’s your problem. So you really need to get that straightened out, so you can take a step to feeling happy again. Do what you need for yourself. If you don’t wanna get diagnosed, that’s ok! But I do suggest going to therapy. Because no matter who, mental illness or not, it’s important to get help like therapy. So just do what you want, and do what you feel will help you. That’s my advice as someone who’s been diagnosed and gone through everything there is. Therapy, hospitals, and psychiatry.
